observed: Rimehorn uses dusky blue, grey fur, weathered ivory and broad adult bodies; Sable uses rust/ochre cloth, indigo and black lamellar. They read as separate faction sets at native scale.
Each colonist has a cart on screen left and one adult puller on screen right. Each cavalry image contains one complete horse and rider facing screen right.

Guards, heavy infantry and spearmen retain separate shield and weapon silhouettes. Full long spear poles fit inside 64-pixel canvases, so spearman bodies are smaller than guards; final art direction acceptance remains with the root reviewer.
Engineers retain a hammer/tool-apron silhouette, surveyors a staff/map silhouette, and marshals a command mantle. Equipment remains compact and static; no animation claim is made.

Rimehorn settlement tiers distinguish open snow-roof lodges, an enclosed town and a larger stone-walled city. Sable version2 village is a dry three-yurt/awning cluster; town and city introduce progressively larger enclosed civic structures.

Rimehorn crossed-beam heraldry and Sable three-notch heraldry remain readable. Sable crest has ivory framing from the original generation; its center seal is three ochre notches, not the Rimehorn cross.

No processed contact-sheet silhouette visibly overlaps a neighboring asset or its own canvas edge. Native palette mapping is high contrast, especially fur, armor and dense settlement roofs; final acceptance should consider that material texture at gameplay zoom.
